record.summary: The consumer side: manual-ack consumption from the durable classic queue under bounded prefetch, batched idempotent inserts into the frames hypertable, ack strictly after commit, poison dead-lettering, per-well gap tracking with heal events, and per-second end-to-end latency histograms. The data path contains no test-only branches.
record.title: Ingest consumer: ack-after-commit, idempotent batched sink, gap accounting
